items.title: Sheaves and modules as filtered colimits of standard presentations built from a basis of quasi-compact objects
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that every sheaf of sets (and, for a sheaf of rings, every module) is a filtered colimit of the standard coequalizer (respectively cokernel) presentations whose terms are coproducts of representable sheaves or of the sheaf-theoretic direct images j_{U!}O_U along members of a basis. The proof of the set-theoretic statement uses a surjection onto the sheaf from a coproduct of representables, applies it to the fibre product to exhibit the sheaf as a coequalizer, and then cuts the index sets down to finite subsets using quasi-compactness, so that the sheaf is a filtered colimit of finitely presented pieces (proof lines 5471-5515). H3: the reduction to a coequalizer and the finite-cut argument with quasi-compactness are independent research-level work, not a citation.
